title: Jovial Roasted Kenyan Pinto Bean Stew
description: A hearty and romantic Kenyan stew featuring roasted pinto beans in a rich and gooey sauce, perfect for a diabetic-friendly dinner
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Rinse the dried pinto beans and soak them in water for at least 8 hours.
Drain and rinse the soaked pinto beans, then transfer them to a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 20 minutes.
In a large pot, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat and saute the chopped onion until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic to the pot and saute for an additional 1 minute.
Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the roasted pinto beans, salt, black pepper, and water to the pot, then bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the stew for 30 minutes, until the flavors have melded together and the sauce has thickened.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
